text:
maya: FYI warm-pool onboarding in us-west stalled this morning after egress default-deny rollout. warmpool stuck ~38%, a bunch of keystore decrypt 403s.

ali: saw the alert. are we blocking privatelink or is KMS denying?

neha: sample from node: ```
2026-03-22T07:12:05Z WARN keystore: decrypt failed status=403 caller=redwood-warmpool-role
2026-03-22T07:12:05Z ERROR join: token exchange failed: tls handshake
```

jordan: firewall rule tightened denied 10.200.5.0/24 (keystore privatelink). dry-run missed warmpool tag.

sre-oncall: repro'd in staging. conntrack shows TCP RESET to keystore IP. audit exporter also 403->siem.

maya: impact: autoscaler fell back to on-demand, ~$1.1k cost spike and short latency SLO blip.

ali: short fix: open egress to keystore CIDR + SIEM host for warmpool subnets for 2h, annotate with CMP-882. then shrink back and do compliance review.

neha: also saw an IAM/KMS policy change yesterday (iam-team#1729) that didn't include the rotated role ARN. updating key policy to allow `redwood-warmpool-role`.

jordan: SRE will apply a temporary firewall allow rule with TTL=7200 and run joins. infra-bot please plan.

sre-oncall: applied temporary allow. nodes are rejoining.

(10m)

jordan: warm-pool at 94%, a couple nodes hit legacy logs domain, adding logs-legacy.partner:443.

neha: KMS key policy updated, decrypts succeeding: `INFO keystore: decrypt ok key=alias/redwood-warmpool`.

maya: keep exception 1h, then remove and validate. open postmortem with security+infra.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-092 created and resolved after 2h.

maya: follow-ups: INFRA-451 (deploy pipeline KMS checks), CMP-882, add keystore CIDR to firewall test-suite and a smoke-check during egress rollouts.
